findings.element: How we get the data: uploaded file chips when Account, Integration or Import method changes
findings.finding: Changing the account, the integration or either import method throws away files already uploaded, with no confirm and no notice, while the 'Use automatic retrieval' link asks for confirmation before it clears the same files.
findings.user_impact: A user who uploads a large export and then moves to a sibling account (Stripe fees to Business Checking) or tries another method finds the file gone with no explanation and must upload it again. This happens on the create screen, where the funnel already loses most users.
findings.suggested_fix: Use the same confirm ('Uploaded files on this screen will be cleared') for account, integration and method changes that discard uploads, or keep files that still fit the new configuration.

evidence.action: Live Chromium probe: Stripe, Account = Stripe fees, Browse (chip 'Integration_export_export.csv'), then Account = Business Checking. Separately: Stripe fees + file, then Integration = PayPal. Clearing, Set import methods, Integration method = Assisted + Browse, then Manual. QuickBooks = Manual + Browse, then Automated.
evidence.observed: In every case the chip count dropped to 0, no dialog fired (dialog listener recorded nothing) and no 'cleared' notice appeared. By contrast, 'Use automatic retrieval' with a file shows native confirm 'Switch to automatic retrieval? Uploaded files on this screen will be cleared.' and then the notice 'Uploaded files cleared — using automatic retrieval.'

findings.element: How we get the data: panel after clicking 'Set import methods' (Stripe clearing)
findings.finding: After 'Set import methods', both sides show 'Automated (recommended)', which is the same setup as the automatic card, yet the panel drops the automatic card's explanation and the link now reads 'Use automatic retrieval', as if the current state were not automatic.
findings.user_impact: The user can't tell whether the page changed how their data will be fetched. They may think they left automatic retrieval, or miss that Synder still pulls data and emails them after a few hours.
findings.suggested_fix: While both sides are Automated, keep the 'Synder pulls QuickBooks and Stripe for this period…' line in the panel and word the link so it doesn't suggest automatic retrieval is off.

evidence.action: Stripe + 'Stripe mzkt.by (required for Synder)', click 'Set import methods', then Run without changing either select
evidence.observed: Before: 'Set import methods / Automatic file retrieval Recommended / Synder pulls QuickBooks and Stripe for this period. Large pulls can take a few hours — we’ll email you when it’s ready.' After: 'Use automatic retrieval / Accounting … Automated (recommended) / Integration … Automated (recommended)' with no pull or hours line. Run still gives 'Reconciliation started', the same result as the automatic card.

findings.element: How we get the data: reason line for Stripe fees / Business Checking / PayPal / Shopify
findings.finding: The reason line says automatic retrieval isn't available ('only available for the Stripe clearing account' / 'isn’t available for PayPal — upload its files below'), but right under it the QuickBooks side still shows 'Automated (recommended)'. The line never says it only covers the integration side.
findings.user_impact: After switching to a non-clearing account or to PayPal/Shopify, users can't tell whether they must also export and upload from QuickBooks. Some will switch QuickBooks to Manual and upload a general ledger they didn't need.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the reason line name the integration side only, and say QuickBooks data is still pulled automatically.

evidence.action: Select Stripe, Account = Stripe fees; separately select PayPal, Account = PayPal clearing
evidence.observed: Data section reads 'Automatic retrieval is only available for the Stripe clearing account. Upload the Stripe file for this account…' (or '…isn’t available for PayPal — upload its files below.') followed by 'Accounting … My lovely money (QuickBooks Online) Import method * Automated (recommended)'

gaps: Retrieval failure and empty-result states are not implemented, so it's unknown what the user sees when an automatic pull fails (the KF-9 preconditions: missing mappings, closed period, lost QBO auth).
Results screen not built: consequences after 'Reconciliation started' can't be judged.
Assisted mode with two upload zones: my Browse loop produced only one chip, so I didn't verify the 'both files present' Run path in Assisted mode.
Shopify showing Assisted/Manual against the spec's Automated/Manual is an open question for Ignat. It was not assessed under the UX lens.
